title: Trump Signs Bill to Deepen US-Taiwan Ties Amid China Concerns
description: President Donald Trump on Tuesday signed into law a measure forcing the US State Department to review guidelines for the country’s engagement with Taiwan, according to the White House, amid escalating concerns that China could move against the self-governing island.

title: China, evoking World War II, urges Europe to take its side against Japan
